I replied to Ilse in her #north-random thread. I thanked her and noted that the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June.

I didn't change anything, since she said no action was needed. I did point out that I don't keep notes between conversations. That means her post in #north-team still shows the wrong date, so I suggested she edit it or reply there.

I didn't read #north-team or search gbrain, because this was a correction with nothing to look up. The renewal date isn't a finance figure, so there was nothing to get approved.
